news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

news_mentions.headline: New Orleans Saints training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Michael Baca provides a refresher on the New Orleans Saints' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams michael baca has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc south catch up on the new orleans saints offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies veterans location ochsner sports performance center metairie louisiana fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at los angeles chargers 4 05 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 10 week 2 vs jacksonville jaguars 1 p m et nfl network on sunday aug 17 week 3 vs denver broncos 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note the saints are one of just three teams browns titans that do not have a prime time game on their schedule nfl research what you need to know 1 kellen moore s undertaking as head coach highlights the immense change happening in new orleans and how the saints adapt to a long overdue overhaul is at the forefront of everyone s mind entering 2025 coming off a super bowl winning season as the eagles offensive coordinator moore brings expertise on offense and a philosophy switch that has been yearned for in the big easy after former defensive coordinator dennis allen followed the sean payton era moore s lone season as oc in philadelphia offers some proof he can successfully acclimate his system to a new team but the disparity in talent won t make it such a seamless transition especially after derek carr s abrupt retirement in may moore s arrival is certainly a breath of fresh air on the surface but how the 36 year old rookie head coach the youngest in the nfl successfully acclimates to the role remains to be seen training camp will provide a first glimpse at moore s initial impact 2 moore s major project during training camp will be figuring out who will lead his offense under center jake haener spencer rattler and second round pick tyler shough enter a three way quarterback competition while undrafted rookie hunter dekkers also looks to get noticed the trial offers great challenges considering the young qbs and the entire offense will be learning a new system rattler enters with the most experience after notching six starts during his rookie season last year his struggles eventually had the saints turn to haener for a start but neither notched a win in carr s absence perhaps that s why shough enters his first training camp with the greatest anticipation in new orleans the 25 year old louisville product comes in with seven years of college experience sports a strong arm that sets him apart from his competition and has a good chance at becoming the first saints rookie to start week 1 since archie manning did it in 1971 having such a rare occurrence coincide with moore s undertaking makes for a stimulating storyline that s appropriate for this new era of saints football but the rookie must win the job first 3 the saints defense could provide some upside in moore s first season several familiar veterans remain at every level including cameron jordan demario davis and tyrann mathieu but the defense will need to adjust to new defensive coordinator brandon staley s 3 4 scheme after a decade under dennis allen the unit s roster makeup isn t short of talent or depth chase young carl granderson bryan bresee and khalen saunders return with jordan on a defensive line that welcomes newcomer davon godchaux davis and pete werner return as the team s leading tacklers last season and will help guide a tackling machine in rookie danny stutsman isaac yiadomwas signed to man the outside corner with kool aid mckinstry returning on the other side and alontae taylor manning the nickel justin reid is the biggest new addition to the defense bringing championship mettle after three seasons with the chiefs and completing a louisiana born backend alongside the honey badger the pieces are seemingly all there but how they fall into place is the big question

news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen and the Bills flip the script on the Texans' ferocious defense? Do the Buccaneers or Bengals prevail in a potential shootout? Will the Cowboys get off on the right foot against the Giants? Check out the Week 1 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension editor s update atlanta ruled tua tagovailoa oblique out of sunday s game making cooper rush the falcons starting quarterback vs the steelers why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel fatigue there s no time to fix it visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Week 1 fantasy sleepers: RB David Montgomery, WR Marvin Harrison Jr. among high-upside lineup plays
news_mentions.description: Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 1, including a pair of young receivers with eerily similar draft pedigrees and two running backs with high upside on Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: hear me and rejoice football is back no more burning the midnight oil mock drafting until your phone dies no more defending your zero rb draft strategy while your group chat tries to dissuade you no more internal conflicts about who to take with your first round pick no more you ve got your team now the real work begins leagues are hardly ever won on draft night and this year will be no different the waiver wire must be walked ever so tightly lest you find yourself at an ihop with a 24 hour timer that goes down 60 minutes with each pancake consumed week 1 always provides a precarious set of circumstances but we must try our best to ascertain the fortunes told in even the foggiest of crystal balls a season full of sleepers is upon us here s the first batch note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Arizona Cardinals training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Arizona Cardinals' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the arizona cardinals offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 22 rookies and veterans location state farm stadium glendale ariz fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs kansas city chiefs 8 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 at denver broncos 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 vs las vegas raiders 4 30 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note arizona plays san francisco and seattle in back to back weeks twice weeks 3 4 weeks 10 11 but doesn t play los angeles the reigning nfc west champion until week 14 and then again in week 18 nfl research what you need to know 1 beneficiaries of two first round draft picks in 2024 the cardinals were left wanting much more from marvin harrison and darius robinson in total harrison s 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns as a rookie are pretty solid but many thought the no 4 overall selection would be a superstar out of the gate harrison and quarterback kyler murray furthering their chemistry could well be the team s prevailing storyline this season and that will get going in earnest during camp robinson picked 23 slots after harrison last year played in just six games because of a calf injury this will be a pivotal camp for him especially amid a revamped defensive front one that will offer him veterans to learn from and new faces to compete against for snaps 2 one of the easiest players in the nfl to root for calais campbell 38 returning to the team he began his illustrious career with in 2008 is more than just a feel great story campbell s leadership is just as important an addition as his talent to a club looking for its first winning season since 2021 this is a pivotal season for the monti ossenfort jonathan gannon regime and campbell pass rusher josh sweat and defensive tackle dalvin tomlinson should add some veteran moxie to a team lacking it outside of star safety budda baker gannon was hired for his defensive prowess coordinating the philadelphia eagles now his arizona d is finally stocked up at least on paper it s added some experienced talent and two high profile rookies in defensive lineman walter nolen first round no 16 overall and cornerback will johnson second no 47 johnson has the ceiling to become a massive draft steal how the cards defensive additions mesh with the starting staples begins this summer 3 james conner joined arizona in 2021 and has been a stellar fit who has exceeded his output and importance with the pittsburgh steelers for four years prior he s coming off career high tallies in carries 236 and rushing yards 1 094 but is entering his age 30 season 2024 third rounder trey benson 63 carries for 291 yards had a disappointing debut campaign but if he finds his footing could he push conner for touches it ll be interesting to see how camp develops in the arizona offensive backfield

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 1 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen and the Bills flip the script on the Texans' ferocious defense? Do the Buccaneers or Bengals prevail in a potential shootout? Will the Cowboys get off on the right foot against the Giants? Check out the Week 1 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension editor s update atlanta ruled tua tagovailoa oblique out of sunday s game making cooper rush the falcons starting quarterback vs the steelers why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease news_mentions.headline: AFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bengals, Browns, Ravens, Steelers
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top AFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Baltimore Ravens, Cincinnati Bengals, Cleveland Browns and Pittsburgh Steelers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns and pittsburgh steelers catch up on each afc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below baltimore ravens cincinnati bengals cleveland browns pittsburgh steelers three key storylines 1 minter era begins john harbaugh is gone and in steps rookie head coach jesse minter to replace him baltimore needed a fresh start minter is the face of it but with a fresh start comes uncertainty is minter capable of preparing and directing his team toward the super bowl contention that has become the standard expectation in the charm city will the shift from harbaugh to minter a product of the harbaugh family coaching tree be enough to push the ravens back into the postseason or is the similarity between the two too close to produce meaningful change it s not often a team changes coaches and is still expected to compete for division titles and more but that s where the ravens find themselves and as is always the case with rookie coaches there s plenty of learning ahead for better or worse does this move boost baltimore back to the top of the division or will the ravens suffer another disappointing finish like in 2025 2 new oc for lamar with a new coaching staff in baltimore lamar jackson has a new offensive coordinator declan doyle is only 30 years old and less than a year older than jackson which could produce a deeper level of understanding between coach and quarterback but he s a largely unproven play caller doyle spent his first season as an oc under offensive mastermind ben johnson in chicago meaning he wasn t holding the play sheet now he will be jackson who is embracing the new system will need to adjust quickly and help the new coordinator establish a rapport with him in order to maximize the potential of the offense which returns derrick henry mark andrews zay flowers and rashod bateman among others baltimore must find a replacement for departed tight end isaiah likely but if doyle is anything like the coach he spent 2025 under the new oc should produce positive results even if it takes a bit to get going 3 a restored defense a hidden detail in the ravens 2025 struggles existed in their defense a unit that is traditionally a strength but was a sieve early in the campaign the main reason defensive lineman nnamdi madubuike went down with a serious neck injury exposing a weakness and lack of depth up front that rendered baltimore s d mostly ineffective except for the moments in which safety kyle hamilton played superhero to save the day that s not sustainable and the ravens acted accordingly this offseason signing trey hendrickson to restore a fearsome presence in the pass rushing unit madubuike could return in 2026 too and age defying defensive end calais campbell has rejoined the ravens to give them some much needed depth this is the group that minter will direct and regardless of what happens offensively this unit s performance will determine how far baltimore can go in 2026 back to top three key storylines 1 can defense finally deliver a year after navigating the choppy dramatic waters that came with trey hendrickson s holdout the bengals are in a much better place defensively they invested significantly in that side of the ball adding dt jonathan allen de boye mafe s bryan cook and s kyle dugger in free agency before swinging a major trade for dt dexter lawrence on paper cincinnati has finally upgraded defensively and appears poised to chase a super bowl but we all know depth charts only matter so much the bengals defensive inadequacies have led to great frustration in the midst of a third straight playoff less season last december joe burrow openly wondered about his football future largely because he was exasperated by the frequent challenges and predictable disappointments if the d is fixed there s reason to believe these bengals can return to the postseason and embark on a deep run 2 burrow s health can joe burrow stay healthy for once while most of the blame for this team s recent struggles has been rightfully pinned on the defense burrow s lack of availability has also been a near annual problem last season a toe injury required surgery and knocked him out for nine games sending the bengals into a crisis mode that prompted them to trade for joe flacco by the time burrow returned cincinnati needed to be nearly perfect to rescue its playoff hopes an impossible goal the flawed bengals failed to reach in 2023 a similar story played out when burrow missed cincinnati s final seven games due to a season ending wrist injury as is the case with every nfl franchise the bengals title hopes ride on the quarterback s availability that will continue to be true in 2026 3 taylor under major pressure the pressure is on cincinnati s head coach a defensible case could have been made for zac taylor s dismissal after 2025 instead he emerged as the only returning coach in the afc north entering 2026 this time around the usual excuses don t exist the defense is improved and if burrow stays healthy he has the pieces necessary to produce at an elite clip if cincy doesn t live up to the lofty expectations set by burrow the blame will fall on taylor s shoulders his team must succeed in 2026 there is no alternative three key storylines 1 new era begins under monken after six seasons the browns sent kevin stefanski packing terminating a two time nfl coach of the year who produced cleveland s only playoff win since the browns returned as an expansion franchise in 1999 in the same breath owner jimmy haslam opted to retain general manager andrew berry touting the personnel chief s strong 2025 draft class and strangely the improvement of kicker andre szmyt as justification for keeping him around berry responded by compiling another draft class that has plenty of potential in 2026 and continues to rebuild the franchise after overseeing the worst decision made by a gm in the last 25 years if not longer trading three first round picks for deshaun watson who also received a fully guaranteed 230 million contract berry replaced stefanski with veteran oc todd monken who makes his head coaching debut with a team that still isn t quite stocked for legitimate contention monken s arrival seems to have breathed new life into the young browns but with results pending that s all we know about the monken era as of now the most important lesson we could learn from the browns this year might be how much patience haslam possesses because it s unlikely this team will suddenly become a contender in 2026 it s up to monken to get the most out of his players in his first season at the helm 2 serious qb questions cleveland is revamping its offensive approach which had become rather stale under stefanski with monken in charge and travis switzer serving as a first time coordinator a new scheme can t cover for a lack of reliability at quarterback though the browns appear to be laying the groundwork for watson to emerge from irrelevance and regain the starting job while 2025 fifth round pick shedeur sanders lurks in the shadows how long watson holds on to the reins is another story but unless the 30 year old pulls off a miracle and returns to his houston form browns fans can prepare for another season filled with frustration under center which might play perfectly into a plan to select a top signal caller in 2027 s loaded draft 3 how will defense look without garrett and schwartz myles garrett reset the single season sack record in 2025 which proved to be his final campaign in brown and orange berry took a massive swing when he agreed to a forward thinking trade with the rams sending garrett to los angeles in exchange for young star edge rusher jared verse and a collection of picks that includes the rams 2027 first round selection garrett s departure means the browns lose 23 sacks worth of production from last season plus a persistent concern carried by every opposing offense add in the departure of respected coordinator jim schwartz and suddenly cleveland s defense its better side in the last two challenging seasons harbors plenty of questions fortunately the browns still have some studs on that side of the ball defensive rookie of the year carson schwesinger five time pro bowl corner denzel ward verse and promising sophomore defensive tackle mason graham but they re going to need to prove the personnel is strong enough to overcome a change in sideline leadership back to top three key storylines 1 no guarantees in life post tomlin mike mccarthy is back in the nfl having returned to his beloved hometown of pittsburgh to lead a steelers team that is taking on a much different appearance than usual instead of replacing one longtime coach with a young star the steelers opted for the veteran with super bowl experience in mccarthy a move some interpreted as a ploy to convince aaron rodgers to return for a 22nd nfl season if that was indeed the plan it worked whether it bears fruit however remains to be seen mccarthy s track record of directing explosive offenses should encourage steelers fans who have grown tired of watching low ceiling units struggle to compete so too should the acquisition of veteran receiver michael pittman but much of this feels like it s held together by chicken wire at least as of now pittsburgh s backup options behind rodgers are longtime reserve mason rudolph 2025 sixth round pick will howard and 2026 third rounder drew allar if crisis strikes at qb visions of a playoff victory something the steelers haven t achieved since the 2016 campaign will evaporate ideally the mccarthy rodgers partnership evokes memories of their days in green bay that s far from a guarantee along with the steelers annual assuredness to finish at or above 500 now that mike tomlin has left the coaching ranks for a job in television 2 run game concerns pittsburgh became one of the leaders in the nfl s sudden shift toward tight end reliant sets in 2025 leaning on the likes of darnell washington pat freiermuth jonnu smith and connor heyward to beef up and bulldoze opposing defenses though smith and heyward are no longer on the roster the first round selection of arizona state ot max iheanachor should help the ground game but is the backfield good enough jaylen warren is pittsburgh s lead back while rico dowdle arrives via free agency to give the steelers an explosive weapon capable of posting a few huge days as evidenced by his 389 yard outburst in weeks 5 and 6 for carolina last season kaleb johnson however remains a question mark the iowa product averaged just 2 5 yards per carry on 28 attempts as a rookie and hasn t yet proven he can be counted on as a rugged power back pittsburgh will have the hogs to move defenses and create rushing lanes but it will be up to mccarthy to deploy his personnel properly in order to stay on schedule and remain balanced especially with the largely immobile rodgers in the lineup 3 graham to get d back on track tomlin s departure meant the arrival of a new defensive coordinator and mccarthy selected the experienced patrick graham as his new director pittsburgh s defense is paid well but hasn t lived up to expectations of late finishing 26th in total d under former dc teryl austin in 2025 graham s track record isn t a slam dunk either in his last three stops dolphins giants raiders his defenses have hovered near league average peaking at 12th in 2020 with new york and bottoming out at 30th with miami in 2019 to his credit graham found some consistency amid dysfunction in las vegas over the last three seasons guiding the raiders to two 15th place finishes in 2023 and 24 before improving slightly to 14th but 25th in scoring d in 2025 he ll have better talent in pittsburgh which means the true test of his expertise should arrive in 2026 luckily he s working under a coach with a reputation for leading potent offenses if graham can prove himself to be a worthy dc then the steelers might actually be in business back to top

news_mentions.headline: Bucs-Bengals features NFL's two biggest wild cards in 2026; plus, three bounce-back teams
news_mentions.description: Are the two NFL teams with the widest range of outcomes in 2026 meeting in Week 1? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks breaks down a pair of true wild cards. Plus, three bounce-back candidates.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three teams that could make the playoffs after falling short last season but first a look at two genuine wild cards in 2026 in my opinion the cincinnati bengals enter this season with the widest range of potential outcomes in the afc i can envision cincy seriously competing for the lombardi trophy or missing the playoffs for a fourth straight year and in the nfc that team is the tampa bay buccaneers the bucs entered last season with hype and started out 6 2 but then they came apart after the bye ultimately finishing with a losing record and watching the postseason from home ironically these two teams open the 2026 season against each other with the bengals hosting the bucs at paycor stadium on sunday so one of them will get off on the right foot while the other will start the new campaign with a stumble but what s the long view on each squad can both realize their upside in the coming months here are my thoughts three bounce back candidates the bengals and buccaneers aren t the only teams with the potential to return to the postseason after a playoff free 2025 campaign here are three talented squads that could rebound in a major way in 2026

news_mentions.headline: Report: 49ers give HC Kyle Shanahan multiyear contract extension
news_mentions.description: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason, ESPN confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: kyle shanahan kicked off 2026 with a masterful showing in the 49ers victory over the rams in australia but it wasn t the only win he scored this year the 49ers coach signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason espn confirmed friday the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news terms of the deal aren t yet known but shanahan s extension represents a deserved reward and sign of stability in san francisco where the coach has worked in tandem with general manager john lynch since both were hired in 2017 since the start of their partnership the 49ers have won three nfc west titles two nfc championships and have appeared in four conference championship games rising to the upper crust of the nfl hierarchy shanahan has a record of 83 67 over that span shanahan accomplished what was arguably his greatest feat last season guiding the injury ravaged 49ers to a 12 5 finish and a playoff win over the eagles on wild card weekend with that success still fresh in the minds of 49ers ownership the team decided it was time to reward the coach with additional security his performance in week 1 added a cherry on top shanahan previously was under contract through 2027

news_mentions.headline: Report: Patriots to place A.J. Brown (ankle) on injured reserve, sidelining WR at least four games
news_mentions.description: The New England Patriots are placing wide receiver A.J. Brown on injured reserve after the star receiver suffered an ankle injury during's Wednesday's kickoff game against the Seahawks, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: the new england patriots prized offseason acquisition will be sidelined for the next month new england is placing receiver a j brown on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in wednesday s season opening loss to seattle espn s adam schefter reported the roster move will prevent brown from playing for at least four games before he is eligible to return from ir the patriots next four games are home vs pittsburgh and jacksonville and buffalo before a week 5 home game vs las vegas nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday that an mri confirmed that brown suffered a high ankle sprain early in the second half of wednesday s game high ankle sprains typically have a recovery time of about four to six weeks brown suffered the injury when his foot was trapped awkwardly between the turf and a seahawks defender while attempting to make a third down catch a three time pro bowler with six 1 000 yard seasons in seven years brown was traded from philadelphia to new england in a june blockbuster deal that netted new england s 2028 first round pick and a 2027 fifth round selection the move reunited brown with his first nfl head coach mike vrabel who directed brown in his first few years in tennessee brown s arrival provided the patriots with an unquestioned no 1 receiver with star power and big play potential an element new england lacked during its run to super bowl lx in 2025 with brown on the roster the nfl s third ranked offense was expected to be even more productive in 2026 instead quarterback drake maye and the patriots will have to manage without brown for at least next month
