news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.description: Are the two NFL teams with the widest range of outcomes in 2026 meeting in Week 1? In this edition of the Scout's Notebook, Bucky Brooks breaks down a pair of true wild cards. Plus, three bounce-back candidates.
news_mentions.body_text: former nfl player and scout bucky brooks knows the ins and outs of this league providing keen insight in his notebook today s installment covers three teams that could make the playoffs after falling short last season but first a look at two genuine wild cards in 2026 in my opinion the cincinnati bengals enter this season with the widest range of potential outcomes in the afc i can envision cincy seriously competing for the lombardi trophy or missing the playoffs for a fourth straight year and in the nfc that team is the tampa bay buccaneers the bucs entered last season with hype and started out 6 2 but then they came apart after the bye ultimately finishing with a losing record and watching the postseason from home ironically these two teams open the 2026 season against each other with the bengals hosting the bucs at paycor stadium on sunday so one of them will get off on the right foot while the other will start the new campaign with a stumble but what s the long view on each squad can both realize their upside in the coming months here are my thoughts three bounce back candidates the bengals and buccaneers aren t the only teams with the potential to return to the postseason after a playoff free 2025 campaign here are three talented squads that could rebound in a major way in 2026

combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension editor s update atlanta ruled tua tagovailoa oblique out of sunday s game making cooper rush the falcons starting quarterback vs the steelers why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel news_mentions.headline: Report: Bears, D'Andre Swift agree to three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million in guaranteed money, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: d 39 andre swift s 2026 season will not be a contract year after all the chicago bears and swift have agreed to a three year 33 75 million extension that includes 27 5 million in guaranteed money espn s adam schefter reported on friday the extension provides swift with a raise of more than 3 million in average annual salary and secures the running back s services through his age 30 season 2029 while also locking down a quality running back at a rate that fits swift s production and is also friendlier to the bears salary cap management swift began his career in detroit as a 2020 second round pick out of georgia and never quite progressed to a stage that warranted an extension with the lions who traded swift to philadelphia in 2023 after enjoying a career best year 1 263 scrimmage yards six total touchdowns with the eagles swift moved to chicago signing a three year 24 million deal with the bears in 2024 since then swift has proven himself as a reliably productive weapon averaging 1 365 5 scrimmage yards in his first two seasons with the bears and forming one half of a contrasting tandem with bruising back kyle monangai last season with swift in the window to sign one more lucrative deal and the final year of his existing contract beginning in 2026 bears general manager ryan poles made sure to sign his top back before the season began they ll kick off their 2026 journey on sunday against the panthers with one less financial matter on their checklist

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL Draft quarterback class: Examining when Fernando Mendoza, eight others could make first starts
news_mentions.description: NFL.com senior news writer examines the 2026 rookie quarterback draft class and when Fernando Mendoza and Co. could make their debuts.
news_mentions.body_text: week 1 of the 2026 campaign arrives with zero rookie quarterbacks slated to start under center in an age where first year players are tossed into the fire early it s a relative anomaly marking just the second time in the past 19 seasons there have been no rookie qbs starting to open the season the previous instance coming in 2022 aka the kenny pickett draft it s no surprise we won t have any rookie starting quarterbacks to start the season though the las vegas raiders telegraphed from the start that they d prefer fernando mendoza open the campaign on the sideline his preseason play didn t change that calculus the indiana product becomes the first no 1 overall pick not to start since baker mayfield in 2018 and is just the third since 2008 jared goff with the rest of the 10 player qb draft class buried behind veterans it could be some time before we see a rookie under center notably every single drafted quarterback made his team s initial 53 man roster to open the season not even the late rounders were waived in an attempt to sneak them through to waivers those decisions underscore the importance of developmental qbs two undrafted free agents jalon daniels and joe fagnano also made the initial 53 with daniels winning the backup job behind mayfield in tampa bay as one of the few true first year qb2s daniels actually has a clearer path to potential playing time than most of the drafted rookies after doing this exercise in april before we knew the schedule or how rosters would shake out let s follow up and see where each drafted rookie is post preseason and when if they might see action in 2026

news_mentions.headline: From Wisconsin walk-on to Bills defensive coordinator: The making of Jim Leonhard
news_mentions.body_text: jim leonhard has spent his life chasing things beyond his reach the buffalo bills 39 new defensive coordinator was a maybe 5 foot 8 kid from tony wis population 105 his teensy high school has gotten tinier since he left and now plays eight man football leonhard amassed every accolade you could imagine at flambeau high he broke records was voted captain earned all state recognition in three sports was named all academic struck out 19 batters in a seven inning game and won slam dunk competitions a no scholarship college star an undrafted nfl keystone an entry level assistant coach who skyrocketed to national prominence within a year leonhard 39 s pursuit of excellence has defied all who 39 ve wondered if he truly had what it took 34 part of what comes with being in a small town is knowing there 39 s always bigger and better out there 34 leonhard said 34 i always had my eyes on that i don 39 t know what it is but i 39 ve got to go find it 34 so i didn 39 t compare myself to anybody in this little world i was in i knew there was more i wanted to go compete let 39 s go chase the guy that you 39 re not seeing 34 he received zero division i scholarship offers because he 39 s small leonhard walked onto the university of wisconsin football team played as a true freshman led the country in interceptions as a sophomore and became a three time all american but the nfl didn 39 t draft him because he 39 s small yet he stuck for 10 years with the bills new york jets baltimore ravens denver broncos and cleveland browns through guile he was a valuable commodity nfl coaches rex ryan and mike pettine relied on him not only to run their defenses but also to interpret them for his teammates those traits translated directly to coaching one year into the vocation wisconsin promoted him to defensive coordinator his units routinely ranked among the top five nationally in total defense before he turned 40 he 39 d spurned an offer from the green bay packers and interest from university of alabama coach nick saban in 2022 wisconsin hired a new coach passing over leonhard a move badgers fans lament leonhard dominated his next transition too joining the denver broncos and quickly establishing himself as a rising nfl coaching star now the bills are counting on him to help deliver what has remained beyond their reach a super bowl championship to learn about how leonhard has defied expectations throughout his life nbsp the athletic spoke to his mentors teammates and admirers leonhard was such an afterthought as a wisconsin freshman in 2001 that his name didn 39 t appear in the media guide the next year still without a scholarship he was wisconsin 39 s first sophomore since 1947 to be named team mvp paul chryst former wisconsin coach jim 39 s story is legendary on that campus everybody knows it barry alvarez former wisconsin football coach and athletics director i 39 ll never forget the first day in freshman camp i told our secondary coach 34 have that leonhard kid work with the second unit 34 he said 34 who are you talking about 34 i said 34 the little guy who gets his hands on every goddamn ball that 39 s thrown 34 leonhard there was a lot i had to learn but i got to be a backup and played special teams that success helped elevate me to the next step alvarez when he shows up he 39 s not very imposing not real impressive but you can 39 t deny his athletic ability he ran a 4 4 in the 40 yard dash we would have dunk contests and he would stuff the basketball any way you wanted it leonhard halfway through camp my sophomore year the starter decided to transfer from that point it wasn 39 t necessarily a blur but everything happened really fast i had a great spring and earned a lot of respect from the coaches ryan who coached leonhard with the ravens jets and bills he was an all american and led in interceptions and punt returns that didn 39 t come by luck leonhard was voted first team all america three times yet went undrafted in 2005 the bills signed him as a rookie free agent pettine who coached leonhard on ryan 39 s staffs and as browns head coach you didn 39 t think this was a guy who could start at safety for you you thought he was going to do your taxes ryan it 39 s hard to recognize a player like that because you 39 ve got to be able to have confidence in your eyes most scouts miss it because 34 he 39 s not big enough 34 well who 39 s making all the plays who can handle all the pressure darrelle revis hall of fame cornerback and jets teammate if you don 39 t pass the eye test that 39 s one thing remember tom brady 39 s combine photos we 39 ve got to see what kind of player you are between the white lines he proved it every day rod woodson hall of fame defensive back he was a gym rat this was told to me as a rookie in 1987 every player on an nfl roster has talent everybody they are the best out of the best out of the best in the world jim just didn 39 t fit the mold matt bowen former bills safety and special teamer special teams back then was the wild west you had four man wedges on kickoffs and trap blocks if you 39 re going to run down that field on kickoff you 39 re going to hit hard and it 39 s going to hurt jimmy loved doing that stuff john guy former bills vice president of pro personnel everything about him was plus plus plus he had courage dependable reliable he didn 39 t make mistakes he didn 39 t miss tackles bowen he handled himself like a 12 year vet i missed a lot of games with a crack in my fibula to stay mentally involved while i was out i would study third down tendencies of our next opponent and share with the other dbs i 39 m a veteran sitting down to tell this rookie what the patriots do on third and 2 to 6 but he already knew it in 2008 buffalo declined to re sign leonhard after three seasons he landed with baltimore as a deep backup when strong safety dawan landry suffered a career threatening neck injury that september leonhard became the starter on a loaded defense guy his size and some injuries made it tough to keep a player like that over guys you 39 ve drafted we were at the point where we needed so many different things that we could never get it right pettine john harbaugh had just gotten hired by the ravens you get an extra minicamp as a staff before the draft because of a new head coach and we were very light on safeties we needed extra bodies to eat up reps just so we can do 11 on 11 work ryan i remember telling ravens gm ozzie newsome 34 if we want to keep the best players i want this f ing kid right here 34 guy jimmy got a full opportunity in baltimore to carry the load sometimes it takes another opportunity to show what you really got leonhard you sit back and think 34 damn i 39 ve played with some pretty impressive players 34 much of that group is in canton or on their way to canton pettine we had great players that we wanted to take the thinking off their plate you never want to slow a special talent down because he has to process too much information we used the term 34 thinking buddy 34 and jimmy was multiple players 39 34 thinking buddy 34 we told jim 34 if they make a mistake for a mental error that 39 s your fault 34 and he welcomed that ryan he was probably at his best in the biggest games just a clutch player we beat tennessee in the 2008 09 playoffs he forces a couple fumbles and does it all we left that stadium having two tight ends playing defensive end to win the game just beat to s didn 39 t matter that sucker played his ass off the jets hired ryan to be their head coach in 2009 he brought leonhard as a foundational piece revis jim came in with a certain type of leadership from the ravens those guys were winning a lot with ed reed and ray lewis and the way they demand the same type of approach to the game from everybody 133 that 39 s what jim did for us it changes your organization jim o 39 neil defensive assistant with the jets bills and browns i had just got hired by the jets to coach safeties my first year in the nfl now i was coaching a brilliant player who knew the system better than i did ryan i 39 ve been around a lot of damn smart players but having jim was a luxury he 39 s a chess master two steps ahead all the time o 39 neil he was a pain in my ass i always felt like i had to stay one night ahead of him in my prep he challenged me every single day with maybe the toughest scheme questions you could get ryan we had veteran safety kerry rhodes who wanted to call the defense well that lasted about two days jimmy just took it over revis i really loved playing with him his intellect his football iq the way he communicated he was just very tuned in and detailed pettine he 39 s a calming influence he could think clearly in a firestorm ryan when he was in there we were the best defense in the league and it wasn 39 t close leonhard started 30 consecutive games for the jets including playoffs but in a 2010 week 13 practice collision with receiver patrick turner leonhard broke his right shinbone ryan when he got hurt it cost us a super bowl i 39 m convinced of that revis that was a big blow we were really balling out and he was an anchor pettine it happened on a friday we went and lost to the patriots 45 3 we 39 d beaten them already that year and would beat them again a month later in the playoffs but when you lose a guy like jim he brings the value of more than just one person ryan no way in hell we would have been beaten by pittsburgh in the afc championship game had jimmy been healthy as ryan and pettine moved on to other teams they repeatedly brought leonhard with them as an on field lieutenant pettine he was one of those rare players that could provide an understanding of what we were trying to do he truly understood the why o 39 neil he was a great bridge for the coaches to think about things from a player 39 s perspective pettine he wasn 39 t afraid to say 34 hey the guys are a little hung up on this one 34 or 34 you might be overloading the guys with this 34 133 it was a no brainer he was going to coach it was just such a natural thing because he has a gift bowen he loves his craft he 39 s a grinder leonhard retired from playing after the 2014 season he joined wisconsin 39 s staff as a defensive backs coach in 2016 chryst i talked to him to see if he just wanted to be around it get a taste of it leonhard i got into coaching thinking 34 this is year to year let 39 s see how long this lasts 34 i just wanted to go back to madison and help max out what that place could be woodson a former big ten network analyst when he first got the job i thought 34 is that the jim leonhard who played in the nfl 34 i had to google it up 34 that is him 34 i 39 ve been rooting for him as a coach ever since chryst when i had a chance to name a new defensive coordinator in 2017 i felt like jim was everything we needed he had coached only one season but he had so much football experience there wasn 39 t a lot of discussion bowen jimmy 39 s defense at wisconsin was a great study multiple fronts simulated pressures creating numbers advantages in terms of blitzes and coverages taking away what opponents do best pettine when you were evaluating college players you looked forward to getting to watch wisconsin film o 39 neil they were badass wisconsin fired chryst in october 2022 and named leonhard interim head coach for the final seven games wisconsin then hired university of cincinnati coach and longtime ohio state assistant coach luke fickell instead chryst i thought news_mentions.headline: Report: 49ers give HC Kyle Shanahan multiyear contract extension
news_mentions.description: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason, ESPN confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: kyle shanahan kicked off 2026 with a masterful showing in the 49ers victory over the rams in australia but it wasn t the only win he scored this year the 49ers coach signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason espn confirmed friday the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news terms of the deal aren t yet known but shanahan s extension represents a deserved reward and sign of stability in san francisco where the coach has worked in tandem with general manager john lynch since both were hired in 2017 since the start of their partnership the 49ers have won three nfc west titles two nfc championships and have appeared in four conference championship games rising to the upper crust of the nfl hierarchy shanahan has a record of 83 67 over that span shanahan accomplished what was arguably his greatest feat last season guiding the injury ravaged 49ers to a 12 5 finish and a playoff win over the eagles on wild card weekend with that success still fresh in the minds of 49ers ownership the team decided it was time to reward the coach with additional security his performance in week 1 added a cherry on top shanahan previously was under contract through 2027

news_mentions.headline: Ravens DL Nnamdi Madubuike won't play Sunday, but says return is close
news_mentions.body_text: owings mills md baltimore ravens head coach jesse minter ruled out nnamdi madubuike for sunday 39 s regular season opener against the indianapolis colts but said that the standout defensive lineman is 34 really really close 34 to game action madubuike a two time pro bowl selection who totaled 19 189 sacks in 2023 and 2024 played in baltimore 39 s first two games last year but missed the rest of the season with a neck injury that put his nfl future in question madubuike had neck surgery in april and was on the field for the start of training camp in july however the ravens and the 28 year old have taken it very slow he hasn 39 t participated in full team practice sessions since last week 34 it 39 s been a great process for him to return from the injury that he had 34 minter said 34 feel great about where he 39 s at but we 39 re not going to play him this week 34 minter didn 39 t give a specific timetable for madubuike 39 s return nor did madubuike who spoke to reporters following the ravens 39 practice friday for the first time since he was hurt a year ago madubuike started the news conference by thanking the ravens organization his teammates family and friends for helping him through what he described as one of the 34 hardest parts 34 of his life 34 i 39 m very grateful to be where i 39 m at right now 34 madubuike said 34 i 39 m not going to get into any details of it but i 39 d definitely say that it was pretty grueling i 39 m looking forward right now and i 39 m definitely thankful to be back i 39 m looking forward to what 39 s ahead just like everybody here is 34 madubuike declined to offer specifics about his injury and the surgery he had in april that allowed him to return to the field he did say that he had no doubt that he 39 d be able to return to the field at some point 34 there were a lot of rumors going out there but i always knew i was going to be back 34 madubuike said 34 it was just a process just like any other injury this was my time in which i had to deal with it i went through it and now i 39 m here 34 getting a healthy madubuike back is a significant development for a ravens defense that is intent on rebounding from a miserable 2025 behind minter their first year defensive minded head coach the ravens never adequately replaced madubuike last season they were at times susceptible against the run but they struggled to consistently pressure the quarterback last year 39 s ravens finished with just 30 sacks tied for the third fewest in the nfl madubuike 39 s return coupled with the addition of veteran free agents trey hendrickson and calais campbell should help in that area while madubuike acknowledged that he 39 s still working his way back into shape he 39 s extremely excited about the strides he 39 s already made 34 when you 39 ve played for such a long time when you 39 ve taken care of your body and done everything the right way and it 39 s been a while that you 39 ve been out you really start to appreciate what this really means to you what it really means to be in this building what it means to be around your guys and be out there on the field 34 madubuike said 34 you really don 39 t know what you have until it 39 s gone it was a process but i 39 m here now 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) out vs. Steelers; Cooper Rush to start
news_mentions.description: Quarterback Tua Tagovailoa has been ruled out for the Atlanta Falcons' season opener Sunday against the Pittsburgh Steelers, and Cooper Rush will get the start in his place.
news_mentions.body_text: it s only week 1 but the atlanta falcons are down two quarterbacks tua tagovailoa officially has been ruled out for the falcons season opener sunday against the pittsburgh steelers and cooper rush will get the start in his place tagavailoa suffered an oblique injury during practice thursday while michael penix on his way back from an acl tear last year was ruled out earlier in the week though he s practiced fully undrafted free agent jack strand is set to be the falcons qb2 the writing was on the practice wall thursday when tagovailoa was listed as limited and rush took first team reps like tagovailoa rush is in his first season with atlanta which has had a season s worth of quarterback questions for new head coach kevin stefanski to deal with before even beginning its campaign rush 32 has played in 42 career games with 16 starts the majority coming for the dallas cowboys and two for the baltimore ravens last season having once been a surprising savior of sorts for dallas who was 5 1 over his first six starts with the club in relief of dak prescott rush struggled last season for the ravens going 0 2 as a starter and throwing for just 303 yards with no touchdowns and four interceptions in four appearances for tagovailoa friday s designation is the continuation of a rather dreadful start to a pivotal debut season in atlanta tagovailoa was released in the offseason following six seasons with the miami dolphins who took the alabama product fifth overall in 2020 after his miami parting tagovailoa was quickly signed by the falcons and essentially won the their starting job by default with penix unavailable tagovailoa largely underperformed in the preseason and with penix getting healthier by the day one must wonder if tagovailoa s opportunity to start has slipped away entering his seventh nfl season tagovailoa has guaranteed he ll be unable to play a full 17 game season for the sixth time in his seven years rush and the falcons kick off against the steelers at 1 p m et sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL community remembers, pays tribute to 9/11 on 25th anniversary
news_mentions.description: On the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11, 2001 terrorist attacks that forever changed our country, NFL teams paid their respects on social media.
news_mentions.body_text: on the 25th anniversary of the sept 11 2001 terrorist attacks that forever changed our country nfl teams paid their respects on social media as part of the league s commemoration all week 1 games will feature tributes designed to honor the lives lost recognize survivors first responders and military families and connect fans to the lasting message of remembrance and service that emerged after september 11 we continue to honor the memory of those we lost on september 11 and the heroes whose courage and sacrifice inspired our nation nfl commissioner roger goodell said in a statement earlier this month out of unimaginable tragedy emerged an extraordinary sense of unity and service that brought americans together as the nfl family reflects on this day 25 years later we remember those who were taken from us and support those who continue to carry the pain of that day we also recommit ourselves to the spirit of resilience community and service that remains an enduring example for future generations

news_mentions.headline: Report: Patriots to place A.J. Brown (ankle) on injured reserve, sidelining WR at least four games
news_mentions.description: The New England Patriots are placing wide receiver A.J. Brown on injured reserve after the star receiver suffered an ankle injury during's Wednesday's kickoff game against the Seahawks, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: the new england patriots prized offseason acquisition will be sidelined for the next month new england is placing receiver a j brown on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in wednesday s season opening loss to seattle espn s adam schefter reported the roster move will prevent brown from playing for at least four games before he is eligible to return from ir the patriots next four games are home vs pittsburgh and jacksonville and buffalo before a week 5 home game vs las vegas nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday that an mri confirmed that brown suffered a high ankle sprain early in the second half of wednesday s game high ankle sprains typically have a recovery time of about four to six weeks brown suffered the injury when his foot was trapped awkwardly between the turf and a seahawks defender while attempting to make a third down catch a three time pro bowler with six 1 000 yard seasons in seven years brown was traded from philadelphia to new england in a june blockbuster deal that netted new england s 2028 first round pick and a 2027 fifth round selection the move reunited brown with his first nfl head coach mike vrabel who directed brown in his first few years in tennessee brown s arrival provided the patriots with an unquestioned no 1 receiver with star power and big play potential an element new england lacked during its run to super bowl lx in 2025 with brown on the roster the nfl s third ranked offense was expected to be even more productive in 2026 instead quarterback drake maye and the patriots will have to manage without brown for at least next month

news_mentions.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
news_mentions.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
news_mentions.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

news_mentions.headline: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle) feeling 'really good,' 'super excited' to face Dolphins in Week 1
news_mentions.description: After a practice injury scare, Las Vegas Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty appears ready for the season debut Sunday versus the Miami Dolphins.
news_mentions.body_text: las vegas raiders running back ashton jeanty expects to play in the season opener against the miami dolphins after suffering an ankle injury during practice last month jeanty said thursday from the locker room that he s feeling really good after returning to practice this week via the team s official website jeanty had no injury designation clearing the way for him to hit the field running on sunday it felt good for sure he said of returning to practice any time away from the game is tough but getting back out there with the guys felt good for sure i m just super excited to go out there and play a good game with this team against the dolphins i m very excited after jeanty went down during practice on aug 23 there was immediate speculation that he could miss a little or a lot of time looking ready for week 1 the former first rounder avoided all of that nerve wracking first going down but when i popped up i had a sigh of relief jeanty said i knew it wasn t anything too bad with star tight end brock bowers slated to miss time jeanty being ready to go would be a boon for a raiders squad looking to get off on a positive first step under new coach klint kubiak

news_mentions.headline: Rams coach Sean McVay calls loss to 49ers a 'good humbling day'
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams fell flat in their season debut, getting run over by the San Francisco 49ers in Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: the ballyhooed los angeles rams faceplanted in australia getting blown out 27 7 by the rival san francisco 49ers in a much anticipated season opener on thursday they outplayed us in every facet rams coach sean mcvay said i didn t do nearly a good enough job this is a humbling day for us this will define us only if we allow it to today was one of those days the rams took a 7 3 lead early in the second quarter on the strength of a puka nacua 41 yard catch and run from there things devolved over the next five drives the rams generated nine first downs matthew stafford tossed an interception tyler higbee lost a fumble and the team turned it over on downs twice including once at the 1 yard line meanwhile a revamped defense allowed the niners to move up and down the field san francisco scored on five of its nine possessions and punted just twice both in the first half i always look inside out mcvay said i didn t do a good enough job getting us ready to go there were some opportunities where maybe the game could have flipped but they deserved the win they were ready to go and we ll look at it we ll see where we can improve and be better moving forward but this is a good humbling day this is what can sometimes happen in sports i love this locker room and you know the first thing that i m going to look at is myself and i have to do a better job for a group collectively with our coaches with our players and we ll look at this film and we ll get back to work because clearly that s obviously what we ve got to do and sometimes sports can humble you and today was one of those days much was made about the rams decision to make the 15 hour flight to melbourne late in the week while the niners spent the entire week down under whether it was the jet lag or simply a team that didn t play its starters in the preseason the rams looked sluggish most of the contest the rams scored just seven points in their week 1 loss against the 49ers their fewest in any of the 75 games with stafford as their starter the seven point total marks just the second stafford start for the rams with fewer than 10 points scored the other came in week 4 of 2022 at san francisco lost 24 9 i make no excuses and you know whether you want to say it s about travel whatever we just weren t good enough in that window mcvay said i didn t coach good enough and we ll look at it and we ll move forward and that s where we re at right now but it was a great atmosphere give credit to the 49ers they deserve it and we re 0 1 and we ll move forward as for the debut of myles garrett in a rams jersey the pass rusher led the club with five qb pressures including two quick pressures but didn t record a sack nor a tackle in the contest like the rest of the rams d garrett was mostly impotent versus brock purdy and the 49ers offense the reigning defensive player of the year said his banged up knee didn t feel 100 percent heading into the game this was the worst version of myself that i ve put out there he said and i ve got to be better i ve got to find a way to recover and get back to the player i know i can be and i ve shown that i ve been before

news_mentions.headline: Tua Tagovailoa limited at Falcons practice with oblique injury; Cooper Rush takes first-team reps
news_mentions.description: Tua Tagovailoa appeared to aggravate his oblique during the Falcons' Thursday practice session, leading to a limited participation status on the team's practice report.
news_mentions.body_text: the quarterback situation in atlanta has become more concerning tua tagovailoa aggravated his oblique during the falcons thursday practice session leading to a limited participation status on the team s practice report nfl network insider ian rapoport reported tagovailoa is day to day with the injury and his status for the week 1 opener against the pittsburgh steelers is to be determined backup cooper rush told reporters after practice that he received every rep with the first string signaling coach kevin stefanski might be preparing to begin his first season in atlanta with the veteran as his starter out of necessity i m not sure what happened rush said it s thursday practice practice has to go on and so you re up next we ll see what happens tagovailoa s late week health hurdle isn t the first challenge he s encountered in his relatively short time with the falcons the former first round pick also began camp on the injury report due to a back ailment forcing atlanta to rely on undrafted free agent jack strand and quickly move to add rush via free agency two weeks ago it appeared as if michael penix was nearing a return from his knee injury just in time for the start of the regular season that optimism faded this week when penix was ruled out for week 1 telling reporters he s very close to being ready but wasn t quite there yet with penix out the plan shifted to tagovailoa thursday s events may force stefanski to adjust once again and turn to rush a 32 year old nfl veteran with 42 games of experience including 16 starts for now it s a worrisome sign that the falcons might have to begin 2026 with a quarterback they hoped would spend 2026 as the third string option tagovailoa still has two days left to recover enough to be able to play in pittsburgh on sunday
