news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension editor s update atlanta ruled tua tagovailoa oblique out of sunday s game making cooper rush the falcons starting quarterback vs the steelers why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel fatigue there s no time to fix it visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.body_text: hear me and rejoice football is back no more burning the midnight oil mock drafting until your phone dies no more defending your zero rb draft strategy while your group chat tries to dissuade you no more internal conflicts about who to take with your first round pick no more you ve got your team now the real work begins leagues are hardly ever won on draft night and this year will be no different the waiver wire must be walked ever so tightly lest you find yourself at an ihop with a 24 hour timer that goes down 60 minutes with each pancake consumed week 1 always provides a precarious set of circumstances but we must try our best to ascertain the fortunes told in even the foggiest of crystal balls a season full of sleepers is upon us here s the first batch note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the New York Giants' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

news_mentions.headline: Report: Bears, D'Andre Swift agree to three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed
news_mentions.description: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have agreed to a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million in guaranteed money, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: d 39 andre swift s 2026 season will not be a contract year after all the chicago bears and swift have agreed to a three year 33 75 million extension that includes 27 5 million in guaranteed money espn s adam schefter reported on friday the extension provides swift with a raise of more than 3 million in average annual salary and secures the running back s services through his age 30 season 2029 while also locking down a quality running back at a rate that fits swift s production and is also friendlier to the bears salary cap management swift began his career in detroit as a 2020 second round pick out of georgia and never quite progressed to a stage that warranted an extension with the lions who traded swift to philadelphia in 2023 after enjoying a career best year 1 263 scrimmage yards six total touchdowns with the eagles swift moved to chicago signing a three year 24 million deal with the bears in 2024 since then swift has proven himself as a reliably productive weapon averaging 1 365 5 scrimmage yards in his first two seasons with the bears and forming one half of a contrasting tandem with bruising back kyle monangai last season with swift in the window to sign one more lucrative deal and the final year of his existing contract beginning in 2026 bears general manager ryan poles made sure to sign his top back before the season began they ll kick off their 2026 journey on sunday against the panthers with one less financial matter on their checklist

news_mentions.headline: 2026 NFL Draft quarterback class: Examining when Fernando Mendoza, eight others could make first starts
news_mentions.description: NFL.com senior news writer examines the 2026 rookie quarterback draft class and when Fernando Mendoza and Co. could make their debuts.
news_mentions.body_text: week 1 of the 2026 campaign arrives with zero rookie quarterbacks slated to start under center in an age where first year players are tossed into the fire early it s a relative anomaly marking just the second time in the past 19 seasons there have been no rookie qbs starting to open the season the previous instance coming in 2022 aka the kenny pickett draft it s no surprise we won t have any rookie starting quarterbacks to start the season though the las vegas raiders telegraphed from the start that they d prefer fernando mendoza open the campaign on the sideline his preseason play didn t change that calculus the indiana product becomes the first no 1 overall pick not to start since baker mayfield in 2018 and is just the third since 2008 jared goff with the rest of the 10 player qb draft class buried behind veterans it could be some time before we see a rookie under center notably every single drafted quarterback made his team s initial 53 man roster to open the season not even the late rounders were waived in an attempt to sneak them through to waivers those decisions underscore the importance of developmental qbs two undrafted free agents jalon daniels and joe fagnano also made the initial 53 with daniels winning the backup job behind mayfield in tampa bay as one of the few true first year qb2s daniels actually has a clearer path to potential playing time than most of the drafted rookies after doing this exercise in april before we knew the schedule or how rosters would shake out let s follow up and see where each drafted rookie is post preseason and when if they might see action in 2026

news_mentions.headline: Report: 49ers give HC Kyle Shanahan multiyear contract extension
news_mentions.description: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason, ESPN confirmed Friday.
news_mentions.body_text: kyle shanahan kicked off 2026 with a masterful showing in the 49ers victory over the rams in australia but it wasn t the only win he scored this year the 49ers coach signed a multiyear contract extension with the team in the offseason espn confirmed friday the ringer s tom pelissero first reported the news terms of the deal aren t yet known but shanahan s extension represents a deserved reward and sign of stability in san francisco where the coach has worked in tandem with general manager john lynch since both were hired in 2017 since the start of their partnership the 49ers have won three nfc west titles two nfc championships and have appeared in four conference championship games rising to the upper crust of the nfl hierarchy shanahan has a record of 83 67 over that span shanahan accomplished what was arguably his greatest feat last season guiding the injury ravaged 49ers to a 12 5 finish and a playoff win over the eagles on wild card weekend with that success still fresh in the minds of 49ers ownership the team decided it was time to reward the coach with additional security his performance in week 1 added a cherry on top shanahan previously was under contract through 2027

news_mentions.headline: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) out vs. Steelers; Cooper Rush to start
news_mentions.description: Quarterback Tua Tagovailoa has been ruled out for the Atlanta Falcons' season opener Sunday against the Pittsburgh Steelers, and Cooper Rush will get the start in his place.
news_mentions.body_text: it s only week 1 but the atlanta falcons are down two quarterbacks tua tagovailoa officially has been ruled out for the falcons season opener sunday against the pittsburgh steelers and cooper rush will get the start in his place tagavailoa suffered an oblique injury during practice thursday while michael penix on his way back from an acl tear last year was ruled out earlier in the week though he s practiced fully undrafted free agent jack strand is set to be the falcons qb2 the writing was on the practice wall thursday when tagovailoa was listed as limited and rush took first team reps like tagovailoa rush is in his first season with atlanta which has had a season s worth of quarterback questions for new head coach kevin stefanski to deal with before even beginning its campaign rush 32 has played in 42 career games with 16 starts the majority coming for the dallas cowboys and two for the baltimore ravens last season having once been a surprising savior of sorts for dallas who was 5 1 over his first six starts with the club in relief of dak prescott rush struggled last season for the ravens going 0 2 as a starter and throwing for just 303 yards with no touchdowns and four interceptions in four appearances for tagovailoa friday s designation is the continuation of a rather dreadful start to a pivotal debut season in atlanta tagovailoa was released in the offseason following six seasons with the miami dolphins who took the alabama product fifth overall in 2020 after his miami parting tagovailoa was quickly signed by the falcons and essentially won the their starting job by default with penix unavailable tagovailoa largely underperformed in the preseason and with penix getting healthier by the day one must wonder if tagovailoa s opportunity to start has slipped away entering his seventh nfl season tagovailoa has guaranteed he ll be unable to play a full 17 game season for the sixth time in his seven years rush and the falcons kick off against the steelers at 1 p m et sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL community remembers, pays tribute to 9/11 on 25th anniversary
news_mentions.description: On the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11, 2001 terrorist attacks that forever changed our country, NFL teams paid their respects on social media.
news_mentions.body_text: on the 25th anniversary of the sept 11 2001 terrorist attacks that forever changed our country nfl teams paid their respects on social media as part of the league s commemoration all week 1 games will feature tributes designed to honor the lives lost recognize survivors first responders and military families and connect fans to the lasting message of remembrance and service that emerged after september 11 we continue to honor the memory of those we lost on september 11 and the heroes whose courage and sacrifice inspired our nation nfl commissioner roger goodell said in a statement earlier this month out of unimaginable tragedy emerged an extraordinary sense of unity and service that brought americans together as the nfl family reflects on this day 25 years later we remember those who were taken from us and support those who continue to carry the pain of that day we also recommit ourselves to the spirit of resilience community and service that remains an enduring example for future generations

news_mentions.headline: Report: Patriots to place A.J. Brown (ankle) on injured reserve, sidelining WR at least four games
news_mentions.description: The New England Patriots are placing wide receiver A.J. Brown on injured reserve after the star receiver suffered an ankle injury during's Wednesday's kickoff game against the Seahawks, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: the new england patriots prized offseason acquisition will be sidelined for the next month new england is placing receiver a j brown on injured reserve after he suffered an ankle injury in wednesday s season opening loss to seattle espn s adam schefter reported the roster move will prevent brown from playing for at least four games before he is eligible to return from ir the patriots next four games are home vs pittsburgh and jacksonville and buffalo before a week 5 home game vs las vegas nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday that an mri confirmed that brown suffered a high ankle sprain early in the second half of wednesday s game high ankle sprains typically have a recovery time of about four to six weeks brown suffered the injury when his foot was trapped awkwardly between the turf and a seahawks defender while attempting to make a third down catch a three time pro bowler with six 1 000 yard seasons in seven years brown was traded from philadelphia to new england in a june blockbuster deal that netted new england s 2028 first round pick and a 2027 fifth round selection the move reunited brown with his first nfl head coach mike vrabel who directed brown in his first few years in tennessee brown s arrival provided the patriots with an unquestioned no 1 receiver with star power and big play potential an element new england lacked during its run to super bowl lx in 2025 with brown on the roster the nfl s third ranked offense was expected to be even more productive in 2026 instead quarterback drake maye and the patriots will have to manage without brown for at least next month

news_mentions.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
news_mentions.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
news_mentions.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

news_mentions.headline: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle) feeling 'really good,' 'super excited' to face Dolphins in Week 1
news_mentions.description: After a practice injury scare, Las Vegas Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty appears ready for the season debut Sunday versus the Miami Dolphins.
news_mentions.body_text: las vegas raiders running back ashton jeanty expects to play in the season opener against the miami dolphins after suffering an ankle injury during practice last month jeanty said thursday from the locker room that he s feeling really good after returning to practice this week via the team s official website jeanty had no injury designation clearing the way for him to hit the field running on sunday it felt good for sure he said of returning to practice any time away from the game is tough but getting back out there with the guys felt good for sure i m just super excited to go out there and play a good game with this team against the dolphins i m very excited after jeanty went down during practice on aug 23 there was immediate speculation that he could miss a little or a lot of time looking ready for week 1 the former first rounder avoided all of that nerve wracking first going down but when i popped up i had a sigh of relief jeanty said i knew it wasn t anything too bad with star tight end brock bowers slated to miss time jeanty being ready to go would be a boon for a raiders squad looking to get off on a positive first step under new coach klint kubiak

news_mentions.headline: Rams coach Sean McVay calls loss to 49ers a 'good humbling day'
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams fell flat in their season debut, getting run over by the San Francisco 49ers in Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: the ballyhooed los angeles rams faceplanted in australia getting blown out 27 7 by the rival san francisco 49ers in a much anticipated season opener on thursday they outplayed us in every facet rams coach sean mcvay said i didn t do nearly a good enough job this is a humbling day for us this will define us only if we allow it to today was one of those days the rams took a 7 3 lead early in the second quarter on the strength of a puka nacua 41 yard catch and run from there things devolved over the next five drives the rams generated nine first downs matthew stafford tossed an interception tyler higbee lost a fumble and the team turned it over on downs twice including once at the 1 yard line meanwhile a revamped defense allowed the niners to move up and down the field san francisco scored on five of its nine possessions and punted just twice both in the first half i always look inside out mcvay said i didn t do a good enough job getting us ready to go there were some opportunities where maybe the game could have flipped but they deserved the win they were ready to go and we ll look at it we ll see where we can improve and be better moving forward but this is a good humbling day this is what can sometimes happen in sports i love this locker room and you know the first thing that i m going to look at is myself and i have to do a better job for a group collectively with our coaches with our players and we ll look at this film and we ll get back to work because clearly that s obviously what we ve got to do and sometimes sports can humble you and today was one of those days much was made about the rams decision to make the 15 hour flight to melbourne late in the week while the niners spent the entire week down under whether it was the jet lag or simply a team that didn t play its starters in the preseason the rams looked sluggish most of the contest the rams scored just seven points in their week 1 loss against the 49ers their fewest in any of the 75 games with stafford as their starter the seven point total marks just the second stafford start for the rams with fewer than 10 points scored the other came in week 4 of 2022 at san francisco lost 24 9 i make no excuses and you know whether you want to say it s about travel whatever we just weren t good enough in that window mcvay said i didn t coach good enough and we ll look at it and we ll move forward and that s where we re at right now but it was a great atmosphere give credit to the 49ers they deserve it and we re 0 1 and we ll move forward as for the debut of myles garrett in a rams jersey the pass rusher led the club with five qb pressures including two quick pressures but didn t record a sack nor a tackle in the contest like the rest of the rams d garrett was mostly impotent versus brock purdy and the 49ers offense the reigning defensive player of the year said his banged up knee didn t feel 100 percent heading into the game this was the worst version of myself that i ve put out there he said and i ve got to be better i ve got to find a way to recover and get back to the player i know i can be and i ve shown that i ve been before

news_mentions.headline: Tua Tagovailoa limited at Falcons practice with oblique injury; Cooper Rush takes first-team reps
news_mentions.description: Tua Tagovailoa appeared to aggravate his oblique during the Falcons' Thursday practice session, leading to a limited participation status on the team's practice report.
news_mentions.body_text: the quarterback situation in atlanta has become more concerning tua tagovailoa aggravated his oblique during the falcons thursday practice session leading to a limited participation status on the team s practice report nfl network insider ian rapoport reported tagovailoa is day to day with the injury and his status for the week 1 opener against the pittsburgh steelers is to be determined backup cooper rush told reporters after practice that he received every rep with the first string signaling coach kevin stefanski might be preparing to begin his first season in atlanta with the veteran as his starter out of necessity i m not sure what happened rush said it s thursday practice practice has to go on and so you re up next we ll see what happens tagovailoa s late week health hurdle isn t the first challenge he s encountered in his relatively short time with the falcons the former first round pick also began camp on the injury report due to a back ailment forcing atlanta to rely on undrafted free agent jack strand and quickly move to add rush via free agency two weeks ago it appeared as if michael penix was nearing a return from his knee injury just in time for the start of the regular season that optimism faded this week when penix was ruled out for week 1 telling reporters he s very close to being ready but wasn t quite there yet with penix out the plan shifted to tagovailoa thursday s events may force stefanski to adjust once again and turn to rush a 32 year old nfl veteran with 42 games of experience including 16 starts for now it s a worrisome sign that the falcons might have to begin 2026 with a quarterback they hoped would spend 2026 as the third string option tagovailoa still has two days left to recover enough to be able to play in pittsburgh on sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Sam Darnold expected to miss Seahawks' Week 2 game, but avoids major hip injury
news_mentions.description: The Seahawks will be without Sam Darnold for at least a game, but the quarterback appears to have avoided a long-term issue.
news_mentions.body_text: the seattle seahawks will be without sam darnold for at least a game but the quarterback appears to have avoided a long term issue darnold is expected to miss next week s tilt against the arizona cardinals nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday rapoport added that darnold could miss just a few weeks but has avoided a lengthy absence darnold exited wednesday s 13 10 win over the new england patriots after just five plays due to a hip injury that occurred on a sack the qb limped to the locker room in obvious discomfort coach mike macdonald noted on an appearance on seattle sports 710 radio that the club got really really good news on darnold s hip but declined to put the qb on a timetable we re praying for sam but not like worrying because it s just what it is macdonald said the hip is intact and it s good it s more of a muscle thing macdonald told seahawks reporters during his thursday news conference that he did not have any new information regarding darnold s status but that he hoped by monday to have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack and what we ll do that week the date of the week 1 injury gives the seahawks extra days for darnold to rest there are 18 days between wednesday s tilt and a week 3 matchup against the washington commanders given how quickly darnold was ruled out it would be very good news if the qb only missed a lone game if it is indeed a one or two week injury the seahawks will roll with drew lock as their spot starter starting at arizona in week 2

news_mentions.headline: Will Anderson on Texans' season opener vs. Bills: 'This is an AFC Championship matchup'
news_mentions.description: The 2026 Week 1 slate features a heavyweight matchup between Super Bowl hopefuls, Houston and Buffalo, each favored to win its division and make a deep postseason run.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 week 1 slate features a heavyweight matchup between super bowl hopefuls houston and buffalo each favored to win its division and make a deep postseason run this is an afc championship matchup texans pass rusher will anderson said this week via the houston chronicle two really good teams we have a ton of respect for them the texans have made the postseason each of the past three years under demeco ryans but bowed out of the tournament in the divisional round each campaign the bills meanwhile have made the playoffs in seven straight seasons but have just two conference championship appearances in that span last year s divisional round loss cost coach sean mcdermott his job sunday marks the third straight season the texans will face the bills in houston ryans club won both previous two meetings a last second field goal victory in 2024 and a four point win last year in a game where houston s defense ravaged josh allen for eight sacks the week 1 bout figures to be a tight matchup the texans finished 12 5 in 2025 and all five losses came by one possession per nfl research four of the bills six losses in 2025 including playoffs were by one score houston s pass rush will key sunday s contest anderson and danielle hunter dominated the last contest bamboozling allen into two interceptions and just 253 passing yards in the contest can they do it in back to back matchups allen has taken more than five sacks versus an opponent four previous times in his career in his next game versus each of those opponents gb bal sea mia he took two or fewer sacks and won the bills will open head coach joe brady s first season in the big chair against one of the best defenses in the league the texans d set franchise records for total 277 2 ypg allowed led nfl and scoring defense 17 4 ppg allowed second in nfl in 2025 and was top five in nfl in yards per play allowed 4 8 opponent passer rating 76 2 and takeaways 29 how brady tweaks his scheme now that he s fully in charge will be a storyline that will stretch beyond this week

news_mentions.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye on loss to Seahawks: My impatience 'cost us the game'
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye threw three interceptions that led to a 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the 2026 season opener.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye threw away a chance to swipe the season opening game in a super bowl rematch against the seattle seahawks falling 13 10 following a game sealing interception the pats controlled much of the first half after the super bowl champs lost starting qb sam darnold five plays into the contest after new england took a 10 0 lead early in the third quarter things unraveled for maye who threw three ints on the patriots final three possessions the third year qb blamed impatience on the trio of errors yeah we had the game under control maye said thought we had a good plan to start chipping away and be patient and lost patience and it cost us decisions that cost us the game on my part on my end i vow to myself to be better and realize it s a long season but at same time we can t have those we can t have those it s unacceptable and i know we got to get back to work that wasn t how i play football and how i want to represent my game and playing quarterback for the patriots maye completed 23 of his 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions the bulk of his production came on short tosses and dump offs he went 20 of 23 on attempts of under 10 air yards for 134 yards and a touchdown 8 9 cpoe maye struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe all three of his picks came on deep attempts 20 air yards two more than he threw all last season 1 the three ints flipped the script as the pats watched a road win slip away you can t throw three interceptions coach mike vrabel said drake knows that we put ourselves in some long yardage situations on the one that was probably forced and i think the guy made a great play on the last one the last one was the most egregious after trailing for the first time in the contest maye helped drive to the seahawks 16 with several solid throws and using his legs to pick up pivotal first downs however his impatience again reared its head in range for the game tying field goal with 26 seconds remaining maye forced a pass to mack hollins in the end zone that came up woefully short it was a bad decision and horrific execution i didn t put enough on it to get it out and it was just unacceptable maye said we had a chance to send it to overtime at the worst the only thing you could do is turn the ball over and that s what i did early maye was content to take what the defense gave him and did a far better job finding outlets versus the seahawk pressure packages than during the super bowl however late he began to hunt big plays that weren t there and got burned i just stopped being patient he said that was the big thing we were really good up to the point where i tried to force one down the sideline to romeo doubs we were patient and dumping it off and trying to move the chains and we avoided a lot of three and outs and that was something we try to earn more plays and the explosives will come so just stopped being patient and made decisions that ended up like i said cost us the game maye had no choice but to wear this l this one can t be blamed on the o line or poor calls the qb simply had a horrible string of decisions that cost his club it burns now and it was truly a brutal performance but there is a lot of season ahead reminder the pats lost week 1 to the raiders last year and still made the super bowl how maye bounces back will say far more than one wednesday game in september it s such a long season vrabel said we re going to hold our head up high and we have nothing but the utmost confidence in him and everybody on this football team and he s going to make a lot of plays for us

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Patriots WR A.J. Brown suffered high ankle sprain, expected to miss at least four weeks
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown (ankle) was ruled out of Wednesday's Kickoff Game against the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: a j brown s much ballyhooed debut with the new england patriots came to an abrupt conclusion wednesday night brown injured his ankle early in the third quarter and was ruled out of the nfl kickoff game which the patriots lost to the host seattle seahawks 13 10 the new england receiver suffered a high ankle sprain an mri confirmed on thursday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported brown is expected to miss at least four weeks according to rapoport which is standard with high ankle sprains the three time pro bowl wide receiver went for a low throw from drake maye with seahawks cornerback nehemiah pritchett defending and deflecting the ball pritchett s knee came down on brown s right ankle and the wideout immediately grabbed the ankle brown who was playing in his first game for the pats since he was acquired in an offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles was attended to on the field before limping off to the blue tent he was then accompanied by trainers to the locker room where he underwent x rays prior to his exit brown had three receptions on four targets for 26 yards all of those numbers team highs at the time his biggest contribution was drawing a massive 34 yard pass interference penalty that put the pats on the seahawks 2 yard line to set up the game s opening score brown 29 has played in at least 13 games in each of his seven nfl seasons but he has missed at least two games in each of his last two with philadelphia

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
news_mentions.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
news_mentions.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Raiders TE Brock Bowers undergoes knee procedure, expected to miss a game or two
news_mentions.description: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is expected to miss a game or two after undergoing a meniscus trim this week, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the raiders will start the 2026 season without their top weapon tight end brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday in dallas and is expected to miss a game or two nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday bowers injury occurred during camp but wasn t diagnosed until last week leading to this week s procedure per rapoport and schefter wednesday s news represents the latest health related hurdle encountered by bowers over the last year fresh off a stellar rookie season bowers suffered a knee injury early in the 2025 season forcing him to miss three games in october and hampering the star pass catcher throughout the campaign given an offseason to recover which began early when bowers sat out of the raiders final two games of 2025 the hope was that bowers would be able to return fully healthy and at the form he displayed in his first nfl season his attempt to do so will be interrupted by the surgery which shouldn t keep him out long but does inspire some concern about how he ll perform in 2026 las vegas selected bowers no 13 overall in the 2024 draft and it immediately paid off via a 112 catch 1 194 yard five touchdown rookie season for the georgia product instantly vaulting bowers into elite status among nfl tight ends his health struggles hindered las vegas offense tremendously in 2025 underscoring his importance to the raiders offensive plans they ll begin 2026 in a familiar place without him while maintaining hope this is merely a bump in bowers road las vegas hosts the miami dolphins at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Carson Wentz to back up Kyler Murray in Vikings' Week 1 game; J.J. McCarthy is QB3
news_mentions.description: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Wednesday that Carson Wentz will be the team's primary backup QB to Kyler Murray in Week 1's game against the Packers.
news_mentions.body_text: j j mccarthy s tumble down the depth chart is complete coach kevin o connell announced wednesday that carson wentz will serve as the backup quarterback to kyler murray on sunday against the green bay packers mccarthy will serve as qb3 i m looking at that right now as a week to week thing o connell added carson he s got almost 100 career starts what he was able to do last year from a standpoint of very limited repetition but being able to apply a career s worth of experience that s kind of what you need to do as a backup quarterback when so much of the emphasis is gonna be on getting kyler as comfortable as we can possibly get him it s quite a fall for mccarthy the 2024 no 10 overall pick but one that was telegraphed plainly most of the offseason from the moment murray signed a one year deal in minnesota it was presumed he would start despite koc s insistence that mccarthy had a shot it quickly became clear that murray would be in the saddle week 1 the other indicator of mccarthy s short leash was the club re signing wentz who performed admirably in five appearances last season the crowded qb room which includes max brosmer on the practice squad underscored that the club wasn t going to go through the same qb ordeal it dealt with last year when it let sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building to give mccarthy his shot nine s preseason struggles and an ankle injury made koc s decision relatively easy a team that otherwise should be battling for a playoff spot can t take a chance on mccarthy being the backstop if murray who has his own injury history goes down despite the first round pick sitting as qb3 o connell insisted that he s excited to continue to get a chance to work with mccarthy he s still two snaps away so he s also gotta still prepare the coach added even today he had great questions about the game plan he s bouncing around he s still a beacon of energy on this team those traits are always gonna be there for him j j s still a young player with so much football still ahead of him if and when we feel like he is ready and gives us the best chance being one snap away with limited reps we can obviously do that koc isn t giving up on j j just yet but there isn t much further the qb can fall before the club does move on
