news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen and the Bills flip the script on the Texans' ferocious defense? Do the Buccaneers or Bengals prevail in a potential shootout? Will the Cowboys get off on the right foot against the Giants? Check out the Week 1 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension editor s update atlanta ruled tua tagovailoa oblique out of sunday s game making cooper rush the falcons starting quarterback vs the steelers why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel fatigue there s no time to fix it visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
news_mentions.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
news_mentions.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
material_news_signals.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
material_news_signals.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

news_mentions.headline: New York Giants training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the New York Giants' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

news_mentions.headline: Rams coach Sean McVay calls loss to 49ers a 'good humbling day'
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams fell flat in their season debut, getting run over by the San Francisco 49ers in Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: the ballyhooed los angeles rams faceplanted in australia getting blown out 27 7 by the rival san francisco 49ers in a much anticipated season opener on thursday they outplayed us in every facet rams coach sean mcvay said i didn t do nearly a good enough job this is a humbling day for us this will define us only if we allow it to today was one of those days the rams took a 7 3 lead early in the second quarter on the strength of a puka nacua 41 yard catch and run from there things devolved over the next five drives the rams generated nine first downs matthew stafford tossed an interception tyler higbee lost a fumble and the team turned it over on downs twice including once at the 1 yard line meanwhile a revamped defense allowed the niners to move up and down the field san francisco scored on five of its nine possessions and punted just twice both in the first half i always look inside out mcvay said i didn t do a good enough job getting us ready to go there were some opportunities where maybe the game could have flipped but they deserved the win they were ready to go and we ll look at it we ll see where we can improve and be better moving forward but this is a good humbling day this is what can sometimes happen in sports i love this locker room and you know the first thing that i m going to look at is myself and i have to do a better job for a group collectively with our coaches with our players and we ll look at this film and we ll get back to work because clearly that s obviously what we ve got to do and sometimes sports can humble you and today was one of those days much was made about the rams decision to make the 15 hour flight to melbourne late in the week while the niners spent the entire week down under whether it was the jet lag or simply a team that didn t play its starters in the preseason the rams looked sluggish most of the contest the rams scored just seven points in their week 1 loss against the 49ers their fewest in any of the 75 games with stafford as their starter the seven point total marks just the second stafford start for the rams with fewer than 10 points scored the other came in week 4 of 2022 at san francisco lost 24 9 i make no excuses and you know whether you want to say it s about travel whatever we just weren t good enough in that window mcvay said i didn t coach good enough and we ll look at it and we ll move forward and that s where we re at right now but it was a great atmosphere give credit to the 49ers they deserve it and we re 0 1 and we ll move forward as for the debut of myles garrett in a rams jersey the pass rusher led the club with five qb pressures including two quick pressures but didn t record a sack nor a tackle in the contest like the rest of the rams d garrett was mostly impotent versus brock purdy and the 49ers offense the reigning defensive player of the year said his banged up knee didn t feel 100 percent heading into the game this was the worst version of myself that i ve put out there he said and i ve got to be better i ve got to find a way to recover and get back to the player i know i can be and i ve shown that i ve been before

news_mentions.headline: Niners vs. Rams: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Australia
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams in Melbourne, Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: are you ready for some footy a thursday night friday morning party depending on your location the 49ers rams season opener promises to be one for the history books not just because it s the first regular season nfl contest to be played in australia or that it ll take place at a 172 year old cricket ground nearly a belichick older than soldier field or that it could begin on a friday and end on a thursday time zones maaaaan more simply this clash between the california rivals is set to stand out more for what happens on the pitch than off it los angeles the reigning nfc runner up loaded up on star power ahead of sofi stadium s second super bowl hosting gig jaylen watson trent mcduffie myles garrett aaron donald they re all wearing royal and sol these days so too are returning stars matthew stafford puka nacua and davante adams it s as stacked a cast as we ve seen in hollywood since ocean s eleven will sean mcvay s 11 get off on the right foot in week 1 their old nemeses from up north are in the way san francisco returns many of its notable names brock purdy is handing off the ball to christian mccaffrey and throwing it to george kittle while fred warner and nick bosa are set to wreak havoc on defense there were a few big returns and additions especially in the receiver room deebo samuel is back after a year on the hill while san francisco added mr 1 000 mike evans and rookie de 39 zhaun stribling to the corps but for the most part it s a familiar 49ers outfit that s set for a familiar matchup in an unfamiliar setting since 2017 when kyle shanahan and mcvay were hired in their respective locales san francisco has won 11 of 19 games played against the rams but this is the first time the two will face off in week 1 thursday night s tussle is the first week 1 game between division opponents that each had at least 12 wins the previous season in 15 years per nfl research the aussies are in for a treat and i m not talking vegemite three must know storylines 1 will rams revamped defense still dominate as expected sans donald all offseason no debut was more hotly anticipated than myles garrett s in los angeles then came aaron donald out of retirement and into the fearsome fivesome stealing garrett s thunder with just 11 days to prepare from signing to game day donald quickly became the most curious case of week 1 but to the chagrin of all football fans outside of the bay area the defensive tackle will be held out of thursday s opener instead watching from where he watched the last rams two seasons his couch even without a d there s still plenty of intrigue surrounding l a s defense with garrett mcduffie and watson debuting there s no preparing for the threat of the reigning defensive player of the year especially when he s surrounded by kobie turner braden fiske and byron young expect l a to try to throw san francisco s offensive line off its bearings from the jump especially on the interior without donald and garrett the rams boasted a 40 2 pressure percentage in 2025 second in the nfl with at least garrett on the field on thursday night brock purdy will surely be feeling the heat the question is whether los angeles kansas city style secondary will get bbq d by san francisco s spicy new look receiving corps the niners wr rams cb matchups will be brand new at all levels and therefore unpredictable purdy didn t have much success against the rams last he played them in 2024 but he s undefeated in season openers something s gotta give 2 can 49ers put their unusual summer behind them san francisco s offseason was one to forget to summarize for the uninitiated the niner gang s strange summer included electrical substation conspiracy theories kyle shanahan s car crash which resulted in a concussion and missed time during training camp ricky pearsall s latest setback and placement on season ending injured reserve and owner jed york s arrest in ohio adding to the off field anxiety around the team have been the absences of george kittle and nick bosa for most of training camp and preseason though the star tight end and pass rusher are on track to play in week 1 after their season ending injuries in 2025 will the turbulence of the last two months translate to on field agita for the 49ers they ve overcome a number of injuries in the past to remain competitive san francisco s 2025 run to the divisional round is a recent prime example the leadership core remains intact and the offensive additions of mike evans and de zhaun stribling provide exciting unpredictability to shanahan s offense once thursday hits the 49ers can officially turn the page from their odd offseason to a regular season rhythm but will the stink of the summer linger into week 1 and beyond 3 will travel have any effect niners rams in oz will be a study of a contrast in styles not on field though the rams reliance on 13 personnel and the 49ers league high rate of pre snap motion in 2025 do present archetypal differences no san francisco and los angeles offer two vastly different approaches to travel the 49ers chose to depart the west coast over a week ahead of the melbourne game leaving on wednesday sept 2 from san francisco and arriving in australia on the morning of friday sept 4 the niners have since taken in the city imbibed the celebrated coffee attended an aussie rules football match and generally ingratiated themselves to the local fan base l a has taken a different tack sean mcvay s squad left on the evening of tuesday sept 8 and is arriving in melbourne the morning of thursday sept 10 around 24 hours before the big game just another business trip for the title favorites mcvay says the short turnaround is what s best for the team based on how they ve approached intentional trips before last season the rams arrived in london on saturday morning for a sunday afternoon win over the jaguars but no nfl team has attempted this type of trip before going across the pacific and landing with just a day to get settled for 60 minutes of full contact football it s quite the unique gamble for the designated home team

news_mentions.headline: Niners-Rams in Australia: What We Learned from San Francisco's 27-7 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down the top takeaways from the San Francisco 49ers' 27-7 win over the Los Angeles Rams in Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: niners burst rams bubble lying in wait for an upset in australia the 49ers stunned the nfl s most hyped squad and their division rivals new faces mike evans returning talents fred warner and familiar standouts brock purdy came to play and make a statement kyle shanahan largely carved up the rams revarnished defense with purdy throwing three touchdowns passes and for 205 yards in front of 100 021 fans attending the nfl s first ever regular season game in australia though they only collected three points the 49ers opening drive set a stellar tone with purdy guiding them 65 yards on 15 plays completing 9 of 12 passes with christian mccaffrey rookie kaelon black george kittle returning from an achilles injury deebo samuel returning after spending 2025 with the commanders and evans all catching balls an absolute beauty of a 39 yard td pass to former rams wr demarcus robinson led to a precarious 10 7 halftime lead for the 49ers but in the second half purdy and co squeezed the life out of the rams purdy s 15 yard score to deebo samuel culminated an 11 play 99 yard td march to open the fourth quarter and close out a statement making week 1 win you can t hold a funeral or throw a party based off a week 1 result but this was a dominant win for san francisco against a super bowl favorite that has been everyone s offseason darling the 49ers aren t to be overlooked in the nfc rams fall flat in much anticipated opener when the rams received the opening kickoff they did so as the first team in league chronicle with the reigning ap nfl mvp matthew stafford and the reigning defensive player of the year myles garrett by the time the game ended both symbolized the rams shocking lack of production from their galaxy of all stars stafford was dismal unable to get the rams the league s top scoring offense last season into any rhythm he threw for just 155 yards with no touchdowns an interception and a 61 2 rating the seven points in the loss marked just the second stafford start for the rams with 10 points or fewer scored the other was a week 4 loss to the 49ers in 2022 having won the mvp after leading the league with 46 touchdowns stafford had at least one td pass in every game last season stafford s zero tds were matched by garrett s tackles as the longtime browns standout recorded just his fourth career game out of 135 with zero tackles niners offensive tackle trent williamsboat raced garrett in their heavyweight showdown garrett was credited by five qb pressures one coming in 11 matchups with williams per next gen stats with aaron donald back home in los angeles he had just about as much statistical impact for the new look rams d as garrett a long season still lies ahead but this is l a s first loss by more than seven points since week 12 2024 there were few positives to take from this one other than there being 16 games left in the regular season for the rams to prove they re not paper champions which will surely be the too quick too hot take as they re flying home evans makes phenomenal introduction there was no shortage of shiny new additions for the 49ers or rams to unveil in the season opener mike evans 49ers debut proved to be the most pivotal as the 33 year old looked every bit like the six time pro bowler he was with the buccaneers in his first game playing in a different uniform evans was clutch and in classic form highlighted by a 2 yard touchdown reception in the third quarter off a brock purdy fade it was evans 37th career td catch of 5 yards or fewer tying him for second all time per nfl research he finished tied for the game high with six receptions for 49 yards he had three third down conversions on the 49ers opening drive san francisco wasted little time letting it be known evans will be a big part of its plans but shanahan likewise showcased balance that was missing last year christian mccaffrey 10 carries for 68 yards and kaelon black 14 for 65 split reps while three 49ers caught td passes and six had multiple catches new and old faces meshed quickly mcvay s flux capacitor fails him for first time the rams departed southern california on tuesday night and arrived in melbourne australia on thursday morning roughly a day before kickoff on friday morning aussie time sean mcvay and the rams travel plan in comparison to kyle shanahan and the 49ers taking ample time to arrive and get acclimated drew criticism and will garner more for the first time mcvay s travel itinerary failed him the rams did a quick turn and burn for a 35 7 win over the jacksonville jaguars last season in london arriving just a day ahead of the game with mcvay improving to 3 0 in international games but mcvay lost for the first time in an international game l a looked sluggish to start punting on its first two drives after never having multiple punts in the first quarter last season once matthew stafford hit puka nacua for a 41 yard gain late in the first the rams seemed to be ignited with kyren williams scoring two plays later however they never got out of the offensive mud they left late and they left for home early as stafford hit the bench when l a took over possession late in the fourth conceding the loss defensive returns make difference on the first play from scrimmage matthew stafford was pressured by nick bosa before throwing a pass that was almost picked off by fred warner bosa torn acl and warner ankle were absent for much of last season and their returns beyond just the stat sheets so clearly buoyed san francisco the rams were the top offense in scoring and yards last year but were held to seven points and 290 yards in this one had two turnovers and were stuffed on two of three fourth down attempts warner had a game high 11 tackles while bosa had a four tackles two for loss san francisco got gashed a few times on the run but overall this was a marvelous performance in raheem morris first game as defensive coordinator and no doubt bolstered by the return of two of the nfl s elite talents nfl pro insight for 49ers rams brock purdy s 39 yard touchdown to demarcus robinson traveled 44 yards relative to the line of scrimmage for the longest completion by air yards in purdy s career nfl research sean mcvay lost his first international series game falling to 3 1 his three international victories as a head coach trail only doug pederson s four
